{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Not a weapon, sir. It's a tool of medicine. I wasn't asked to turn over my bandages, bacta treatments, disinfectant sprays, or tranquilizers either, but I can kill a man with any of them, under the right circumstances.|Doctor Ton Phanan, to a stunned Colonel Atton Repness|<ref name="XWIF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>}}
A '''disinfectant spray''' was a tool of medicine.<ref name="XWIF" />

[[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ton Phanan]] was known to carry one due to his role as the squadron's [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]. Unlike some doctors, he was capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] a man with disinfectant spray, among other tools usually used to heal, such as [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. This was a highly unorthodox usage of disinfectant spray, however, and as such the revelation that it could be employed in such a manner was troubling to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Atton Repness]] of [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]].<ref name="XWIF" />
